A1.justification: Both complete 14-page PDFs describe the same FETAL-GAUGE research. The main text, figures, tables, and appendices can be matched reliably.

before.justification: Sections 4–5 report original evaluations of 15 VLMs, fine-tuning experiments, and performance analyses, supported by Tables 1–2 and Figures 1, 4–5.

after.justification: V2 retains these original model evaluations, fine-tuning results, and quantitative and qualitative analyses in Sections 4–5.

M1.justification: The benchmark construction, multiple-choice task formulation, mask-to-box conversion, and reported LoRA fine-tuning procedures are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 13 source datasets and five tasks, covering the same clinical and phantom ultrasound data. Appendix Tables 3–6 retain the same coverage.

E2.justification: The same 15 VLMs, random-guess baseline, and fine-tuned Llama and Qwen variants participate in the corresponding comparisons. No comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: The source/patient-wise splitting strategy, sample counts, accuracy metric, and reported 3-, 5-, 7-, and 10-epoch fine-tuning settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain the same fine-tuning analysis, phantom-versus-clinical comparison, anatomical structure-size analysis, and qualitative failure cases in Sections 4.4–5.1.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All reported result entries and findings are retained. Table 1 still gives GPT-5 overall accuracy of 0.55 and fine-tuned Llama accuracy up to 0.85; Table 2 and Figures 1, 4–5 also preserve their results.

T1.justification: The benchmark and task definitions remain unchanged. Neither version introduces formal theoretical results, mathematical derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The claimed novelty, benchmark scale, five-task scope, and main scientific conclusions are unchanged. The abstract edit concerns resource availability rather than a revised scientific contribution.

C2.justification: The interpretations concerning training-data exposure, ultrasound-specific knowledge, phantom-domain difficulties, and fine-grained localization are unchanged, including the qualitative failure explanations.

D1.justification: V1 promises public release after acceptance; v2 states that the benchmark is publicly available and adds a GitHub repository link in the abstract. Other technical disclosures are unchanged. The PDFs do not establish the linked repository's contents.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, reference list, and positioning relative to earlier medical VQA benchmarks and VLMs are unchanged.

P1.justification: The abstract's availability sentence is shortened and updated, and the arXiv version/date marking changes. The remaining prose and section organization are retained.

P2.justification: Pages 1–2 reflow slightly after the abstract edit. Figures retain their content but are recompressed; Figure 3 decreases from 3236×872 to 809×218 pixels and appears less sharp. Tables and appendix layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: Replacing the conditional release promise with a concrete benchmark link modestly improves access guidance. This limited benefit outweighs the slight loss of figure sharpness; the scientific evidence and appendices are unchanged. The improvement concerns documented access, since repository contents cannot be verified from the PDFs.
